title: feat(objectql): record-currency guards — blank code refuses the write; ungrouped sum/avg/min/max over a record-mode amount refused; summary roll-up over one refused at registration
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-bill"} -->
_Requested by **Bill** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wg?thread=cmsg_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wg9oTskgBVZmtxXLAEh251Cb)_
Fixes #27186

Merge-after: #27268
⛔ not released alone — R1: pairs with #27184, #27186, #27187, #27188 (one Version Packages release)
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么：** record 模式金额写入时币种码为空 ⇒ 拒写（`ERR_CURRENCY_CODE_REQUIRED`）；`sum/avg/min/max` 对 record 金额不按币种码分组 ⇒ 拒收；summary 汇总 record 子字段 ⇒ 注册时拒收；公式引用 record 金额时声明为 record 币种。
- **为什么改：** 测量轮探针里 USD 100 + EUR 100 = 200、USD 100 + JPY 15000 汇总成 15100，都是静默错数；这三道门把它们变成响亮拒收（ADR-0144 D6、D8 规则 4）。
- **风险与回滚：** 只对声明了 `currencyMode: 'record'` 的字段生效，该模式随 #27184 新增，现有字段零影响；回滚即撤本 PR，但须与 R1 同批。
- **先看：** `packages/objectql/src/validation/record-currency-code.ts`（更新路径用存量行叠加载荷判定）；`packages/objectql/src/record-currency-aggregate-door.ts`；`packages/objectql/src/registry.ts` 的注册拒收位置。
- **两分钟验证：** `pnpm --filter @objectstack/objectql exec vitest run --project local src/record-currency-guards.test.ts`，预期 12/12 通过（混币 sum 被拒、按币种码分组得到 USD 100 / EUR 100）。
- **需要你做的：** 无，席位落地（须等 #27268 先合并，与 R1 同批发版）。

## What changes

- **Blank code refuses the write (ADR-0144 D8 rule 4, Open item 9).** `validation/record-currency-code.ts` refuses a row image that holds a value in a `record`-mode amount beside a blank code field (absent, `null`, white space) with `ERR_CURRENCY_CODE_REQUIRED` / 400; `field` names the code field, `amountField` the amount. Judged on insert (each final row), by-id update (stored row with the final payload over it) and predicate update (each matched row with the payload over it, read only when the payload carries an amount or its code). An update that does not touch the pair is never judged, so a pre-existing row is not refused for an unrelated edit. The code is registered under `@objectstack/objectql` in the ADR-0112 ledger (`error-code-ledger.zod.ts`); the generated reference pages are regenerated.
- **Ungrouped raw aggregate refused (ADR-0144 D6, Open item 10).** `record-currency-aggregate-door.ts`, called in `ObjectQL.aggregate` right after the aggregate × field-type door: `sum` / `avg` / `min` / `max` over a `record`-mode amount answers `INVALID_FIELD` / 400 unless `groupBy` names its code field (string or `{ field }` entry). The message leads with the prescription (group by the code field, or aggregate a stored home-currency amount). `count` and `count_distinct` are not judged. No new wire code: ADR-0144 assigns ADR-0112 codes only to the blank-code and missing-rate refusals.
- **Summary roll-up refused at registration (ADR-0144 D6).** `SchemaRegistry.registerObject` refuses, before any materialization, a body whose `summary` field rolls up `sum` / `avg` / `min` / `max` of a `record`-mode child field — or a child body declaring a `record`-mode field that a registered parent already rolls up that way. `INVALID_METADATA` / 422 (`RecordCurrencySummaryRefusedError`), judged at whichever registration completes the pair; an end not yet registered is no verdict.
- **Rider, declared — from #27184's class-c finding.** `packages/formula/src/formula-return.ts`: `currencyOf` mapped every non-`fixed` config to `dynamic`, so `inferFormulaReturn` would stamp a formula over a record-mode amount as a tenant-default amount. It now carries `currencyConfig: { currencyMode: 'record', currencyField }` (the shape #27184's object refinement already judges on a `formula`). Two record-mode amounts are one currency only when they name the same code field; record vs `fixed` / `dynamic` is not one currency.
- **File-surface addition, approved by the epic PM:** `packages/qa/dogfood/test/record-currency-probes.test.ts` (test only, private package, no changeset).

## Tests

- `packages/objectql/src/record-currency-guards.test.ts` (new, 12 cases): the blank-code refusal on insert (four blank spellings), by-id update (clear code / amount onto a row without one / legacy row untouched), predicate update (one matched row without a code refuses the whole write, naming the record); the aggregate door for all four functions, grouped-by-other refused, grouped by the code answers USD 100 / EUR 100 (string and object `groupBy`), `count` and a fixed-currency sum not judged; the summary refusal parent-second (all four functions) and child-second, `count` and a non-record child field register. Every refusal asserts `code` + `status` + `httpStatus`.
- `packages/qa/dogfood/test/record-currency-probes.test.ts` (new): PROBE-A, the write side and PROBE-R on `SqlDriver` over better-sqlite3 and on `SqliteWasmDriver`, 6/6. ⛔ No driver-memory arm: its test consumers are a closed census (`check:driver-memory-census`) and the project's test backends are sqlite `:memory:`; the in-memory aggregation face is the objectql suite above.
- `packages/formula/src/formula-return.test.ts`: a new describe for the record currency (stamped with its code field; ratio of two same-currency amounts is not money; three cross-currency mixes are not money).

## Acceptance notes

- PROBE-A / PROBE-R come from the measurement round's design comment on #8345 (6041378776); the probe files themselves were deleted then, so these are re-authored fixtures with the record currency declared, not the originals.
- The derived gate list includes #27184's paths, because this branch sits on #27268's branch.
- A row that was stored with an amount and no code before this guard is not refused until a write touches the amount or the code; ADR-0144 has no backfill for that state, and `record` mode ships in the same release, so no such row exists in a released build.

## Verification

Readings on head `4201bb53` unless named.

<details><summary>Tests</summary>

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/objectql exec vitest run --project local --maxWorkers=2 src/record-currency-guards.test.ts` — Test Files 1 passed, Tests 12 passed (12).
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/dogfood exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 test/record-currency-probes.test.ts` — Test Files 1 passed, Tests 6 passed (6) (both SQLite drivers).
- Full `@objectstack/objectql` local project at `a1954847` (the guards and wiring as they ship; later commits change only the two test files and generated reference pages): Test Files 478 passed (478), Tests 8911 passed (8911).
- Full `@objectstack/formula` at `a1954847`: Test Files 58 passed (58), Tests 1534 passed (1534).
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/objectql typecheck` (tsc + check:test-typecheck) OK at `901cbb01`; `@objectstack/formula` typecheck OK at `a1954847`. The dogfood package typecheck was not measured: its closure (`@objectstack/verify`, connectors) is unbuilt in this container, and no error line names the new file.
</details>

<details><summary>Ablation (one-shot; suite imports src, no build leg)</summary>

`scripts/ablation-replace.mjs --delete` on the committed tree, restore verified blob == HEAD and `git diff HEAD` empty each time, against `record-currency-guards.test.ts`:
- the `assertRecordCurrencyAggregatesGrouped` call in `engine.ts` — 2 failed / 10 passed;
- the insert `assertRecordCurrencyCodes` call in `engine.ts` — 1 failed / 11 passed;
- the `throw recordCurrencySummary` in `registry.ts` — 2 failed / 10 passed.
The by-id and predicate update call sites were not ablated separately.
</details>

<details><summary>Derived gates</summary>

`node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` derived 120 families (it includes #27268's paths, since this branch sits on that branch, and warned the base tree is behind origin/main). All 120 run; `--ran` reconciliation: 116 run, 4 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN.
- Red on the first sweep and fixed in this PR: `check:docs` / `check:generated` (the reference pages lacked the new ledger code — regenerated), `check:objectql-double-limit` and `check:query-options-erasure` (the new test's driver double and option casts — fixed); re-run exit 0 at `901cbb01`/`4201bb53`. `check:dts-closure` was red once while `packages/spec` was mid-rebuild; re-run exit 0.
- NOT MEASURED (exit 3, prerequisite not met in this container): `check-plugin-teardown-shape --self-test` (shallow clone), `spec check:skill-examples` (client-react unbuilt), `check:dual-build-cjs-loads`, `check:i18n` (CLI unbuilt). CI runs them.
- Re-run on the new head after the test fixes: `check:error-code-casing`, `check:dispatcher-error-vocabulary`, `spec check:error-code-provenance`, `check:nul-bytes`, `check:engine-double-contract` — exit 0.
</details>
